scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix apps/website && npm install --prefix apps/dashboard

scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/website run lint && npm --prefix apps/dashboard run lint

scripts.format: npm --prefix apps/website run format && npm --prefix apps/dashboard run format
